content_units: Best Family Stay for Lisbon, Apr 10–15

For your priorities,   Hotel Aurora Baixa   is the best overall pick. It stays   within the CAD 1,400 lodging budget  , includes   breakfast  , is a   short 10-minute walk to the city center  , and is the strongest balance of convenience and family practicality.
Lisbon Hotel Comparison
Option   Total Price   Breakfast   Review   Access to Center   Fit for Your Priorities
Hotel Aurora Baixa   CAD 1,360   Included   8.4   10-min walk     Best match
Riverside Suites   CAD 1,180   Not included   8.8   22-min tram ride   Weaker on location and breakfast
Alfama Family Inn   CAD 1,420   Included   9.1   12-min walk   Over budget
Avenida Comfort Stay   CAD 1,290   Included   8.1   18-min walk   Good backup, less walkable
Why Hotel Aurora Baixa Wins
-   Central location is your top priority  , and Aurora Baixa is the most walkable option that still fits budget.
-   Breakfast included   helps with both convenience and daily cost control for 2 adults and 1 child.
- At   CAD 1,360 total  , it stays under your cap with a small buffer.
- A   10-minute walk to center   is meaningfully better than 18 minutes or relying on a tram, especially with a child.
- Since you value   walkability over luxury  , its solid   8.4 review score   is strong enough without paying more for premium ratings.
Trade-offs and Compromises
-   Alfama Family Inn   has the best review score and a good location, but at   CAD 1,420   it breaks your stated budget.
-   Riverside Suites   is cheaper and well reviewed, but   no breakfast   plus a   22-minute tram ride   makes it less convenient for a family base.
-   Avenida Comfort Stay   is under budget with breakfast included, but the   18-minute walk   is a noticeable compromise if you want easy daily sightseeing on foot.
-   Hotel Aurora Baixa’s compromise   is that it is not the top-rated property, but it best satisfies the combination of   budget + breakfast + centrality  .
